title: Nebula Solo #013 (보라 성운 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Indian · 메이크업 클래식 레드립 극한 · 배경 기차역 대합실 · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, mid 40s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, top bun balayage hair — full body glowing violet nebula starfield fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid starfield body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a deep cosmos of swirling luminous gas clouds and dust lanes in rich overlapping layers, thousands of tiny bright stars embedded across every curve, a few large brilliant stars with soft cross-shaped glints, thin glowing constellation lines linking the brightest stars across her torso and legs, glowing softly from within, nothing lying flat. Dense cosmic surface — BLAZING deep indigo-violet and magenta nebula clouds across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID tiny white and gold stars and thin gold constellation lines linking the brightest stars, softly glowing, completely opaque, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same glowing nebula starfield, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same glowing nebula starfield with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a gold belly chain with a small pendant resting on her belly plate. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the starfield figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick lacquer-glossy saturated pillar-box red lips overlined fuller than natural, a razor-sharp long winged liner, dramatic lashes, a flawless matte complexion with sculpted cheekbones.

Background: a bright grand railway station concourse with a pale stone floor, tall arched windows, standard-height doors and a long bench, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
